scope: Source-backed complete-core screening, not implementation, training approval, or measured improvement

common_adaptation.input: One Local256 plus Base and active Gap real 8x64 forward heads. Project Local256->64 and each head64->64 into a shared learned descriptor space; add role and actual-head identity embeddings. Exactly 9/17/25 unordered descriptors for legal availability. These are heterogeneous evidence descriptors, not iid temporal samples, image pixels, or an estimate of a population sentiment covariance.
common_adaptation.statistic: Pack only active descriptors X[n,64]; mu=mean_rows(X); S=(X-mu)^T(X-mu)/n. n is active count, never fixed storage33. No artificial spatial layout. Ridge S_delta=S+1e-4 I64 is explicit regularization: n<=25 guarantees rank deficiency without it. Covariance is invariant to consistent descriptor permutations and measures dispersion of this current read set, not change of historical observations.
common_adaptation.insertion: Use the resulting spectral representation z only for zero-initialized affine corrections to existing emotion_adapter input slots, not a replacement task head. Local_adapter=L+W_L0 z; each active real head C_type,h'=C_type,h+W_type,h,0 z. Local skip uses original L; existing Flat, emotion_norm and task classifier remain unchanged. Output heads W have zero weights AND biases. Gap slots remain fixed and inactive slots are hard zero. This shared global-statistic writeback is a declared wrapper, not source architecture or independent novelty.
common_adaptation.masks: Before any projection sanitize with where. Valid-prefix history cumsum(umask)-umask>0; no-history/padded rows bypass the whole branch and every biased correction. Consume emotion-ablation-masked reads, never raw reads bypassing ablation. Pack active descriptors; if all memory evidence is ablated bypass rather than compute a one-point statistic. Re-mask inactive Gap after writeback. Use only real forward512, preserve backward-zero halves. No BatchNorm, new dropout, batch statistics, persistent covariance, extra OSRAM reads/writes, labels, completion or auxiliary loss.
common_adaptation.interpretation_limit: Centered covariance loses first-order means; the original Flat and Local skip preserve their direct information. Head correlation is not automatically useful sentiment evidence. No accuracy benefit is implied.

candidates.title: Towards Faster Training of Global Covariance Pooling Networks by Iterative Matrix Square Root Normalization

source_inspected.finding: Figure1 and Section3 specify centered covariance, trace/Frobenius pre-normalization, coupled Newton-Schulz iterations, scale compensation and differentiation through all stages.

Author implementation uses biased centered covariance1/n, trace normalization, iterative coupled factors, sqrt(trace) compensation and unweighted upper-triangle vectorization. Optional Conv/BN reduction is outside the selected meta-layer.

candidates.core: Full CovPool -> trace pre-normalization -> finite coupled matrix square-root iteration -> trace-scale post-compensation -> upper-triangle representation. No replacement by ordinary covariance, elementwise sqrt, isolated matrix sqrt, or eigensolver-only normalization.

adaptation.equations: t=trace(S_delta); Y0=S_delta/t, Z0=I. For k=1..5 use T=.5*(3I-Z_(k-1)Y_(k-1)); Yk=Y_(k-1)T; Zk=T Z_(k-1), using the same previous factors. C=sqrt(t)*Y5. z=upper_triangle(C), 2080 dimensions. Differentiate the finite five-step map including t and compensation; no detach or extra convergence loss.
adaptation.parameters: Descriptor width64, five iterations, fixed ridge1e-4. Raw2080d output is consumed by common zero-affine slot heads; no extra learned gate or invented factor network. Source allows iterNum; chosen five is fixed and not separately counted.
adaptation.honest_changes: Source image backbone and classifier omitted; common typed real-head projection replaces CNN descriptors. No source BatchNorm because per-utterance isolation. Ridge and fixed64 width are declared adaptations. Trace and upper-triangle conventions preserve the inspected author core.

candidates.masks: Common masks before covariance and before all output corrections; denominators count only active tokens; all-empty or no-history bypass. Positive ridge guarantees finite trace even for identical descriptors.
risks: A complete global pooling meta-layer, not a large trainable interaction network; accept only this full chain, never pad the list with other matrix powers or iteration counts.

Earlier round1 notes rejected isolated iSQRT normalization as a primitive. This card revisits the complete source meta-layer but is not a claim that the previous rejection was experimentally disproved.
Few correlated descriptors make covariance noisy; ridge can dominate low-variance directions. Five-step approximation is intentionally not asserted exact square root.
2080d global-statistic writeback may be parameter-heavy; exact parameter count and numerical tests required before implementation approval.

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: Computes a single centered cross-channel second-order representation with finite normalized matrix-power geometry. VB fits multiple activation-weighted vote posteriors and responsibilities; Hamburger reconstructs nonnegative token factors; LRPCA decomposes the token matrix into signed sparse corruption and low-rank factors. None applies this complete covariance/normalization/compensation pooling chain.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: SPDNet shares only the covariance input wrapper; it learns multiple constrained congruences with spectral rectification before logarithmic charting. Do NOT treat plain sqrt versus plain log covariance as two methods. All attention/VQA/representation cards use token interactions/assignments rather than this full second-order pipeline.
novelty_audit.source_code_evidence: MPNCOV.forward explicitly composes Covpool, Sqrtm and Triuvec; Sqrtm includes pre/post trace scale and finite iterations.

candidates.title: A Riemannian Network for SPD Matrix Learning

code.license: Root code license not verified; independent mathematical implementation only, no source copying. Bundled Manopt has its own license and must not be imported.

source_inspected.finding: Section Riemannian SPD Matrix Network specifies full-rank semiorthogonal BiMap, eigenvalue rectification and LogEig; training section uses Stiefel optimization.
Actual released chain is BiMap/ReEig/BiMap/ReEig/BiMap/LogEig then source classifier. Three dimensional reductions are retained, not collapsed into a single log-covariance layer.
Column-orthonormal W convention computes W' X W; transpose is essential when translating paper row-orthonormal convention.
Reconstruct U max(lambda,epsilon) U'; manual spectral backward handles eigenvalue gaps.
LogEig reconstructs U log(lambda) U' and provides explicit spectral backward; do not naively differentiate eigenvectors at repeated eigenvalues.

candidates.core: Three learned SPD-preserving dimensional reductions with two intermediate spectral rectifications, followed by LogEig Euclidean charting. The learned congruence hierarchy plus nonlinear eigenvalue floor is indispensable; isolated log-covariance is not SPDNet.

adaptation.equations: S0=S_delta64 with ridge1e-4; S1=ReEig_floor1e-3(W1' S0 W1), W1:64x32; S2=ReEig_floor1e-2(W2' S1 W2), W2:32x16; S3=W3' S2 W3, W3:16x8; z=vec(LogEig(S3))64. Fixed stage-specific ReEig floors=(1e-3,1e-2). Keep full64-element final flatten as source classifier input convention, not another square-root pool.
adaptation.constraint_and_optimizer: Keep original global Adam unchanged. Parameterize each effective column-orthonormal W as exp(A-A')[:, :d_out] with learned square A and independent seeded orthogonal initial basis. This preserves W'W=I by construction and needs no extra optimizer or loss. It is an explicit smooth-parametrization adaptation, NOT reproduction of the author's Stiefel-SGD trajectory. Never replace W by unconstrained rectangular Adam weights and claim source parity.
adaptation.spectral_backward: Implement derivatives of symmetric spectral matrix functions via Loewner divided differences: offdiagonal (f(lambda_i)-f(lambda_j))/(lambda_i-lambda_j), continuous derivative limit for repeated eigenvalues; ReEig uses a declared zero subgradient at the floor. Symmetrize upstream matrix gradient. Verify finite repeated-spectrum forward/backward, gradcheck away from threshold and source-equation equivalence. Do not add random eigenvalue jitter to hide unstable eigenvector derivatives.
adaptation.honest_changes: Covariance construction from available read descriptors replaces supplied SPD data. Width64->32->16->8, ridge1e-4, fixed stage-specific floors=(1e-3,1e-2) and differentiable orthogonal parametrization are adaptations, not exact author-source configuration. Original Flat classifier/loss unchanged; no source classification head, manifold regularizer or reconstruction objective.
adaptation.implementation_review_amendment: 2026-10-04: Implementation review found ridge=floor1=floor2=1e-4 makes both ReEig stages mathematically identity under strict semiorthogonal congruences, which preserve the minimum-eigenvalue lower bound. Merely raising both floors to1e-3 still makes the second stage identity after the first. Root approved fixed floors1e-3 then1e-2 so both stages can actually rectify small modes. This is one declared architecture setting, not hyperparameter search or a claim of source-training parity.

candidates.masks: Same common packing and no-history guards. Ridge makes input strictly positive definite even for rank<=n-1; semiorthogonal congruences preserve positivity; no fake sample or missing-feature insertion.
risks: Source includes general visual/action recognition and AFEW; this is a general SPD geometry core, not an MSA/MERC missing-modality method.
An implementation without the orthogonality constraint or stable spectral backward would fail this card; no runtime readiness is claimed.
Matrix exponential and three eigendecompositions cost more than fixed square-root pooling; GPU latency and peak memory require real-batch verification.
Repeated eigenvalues are guaranteed by ridge in rank-deficient covariance, making naive torch.linalg.eigh eigenvector backward unsafe.
Evidence covariance is heterogeneous descriptor dispersion; no iid statistical confidence or calibrated uncertainty claim.

novelty_audit.substantive_difference: Learns a hierarchy of constrained channel-congruence SPD maps and eigenvalue nonlinearities. Sheaf transports node fibers through incidence maps, VB iterates probabilistic assignments, and LRPCA estimates low-rank plus sparse components of the data matrix. No shared core computation with those methods.
novelty_audit.same_round_overlap: Shares covariance input with isqrt_cov_full but not its fixed matrix-power pooling mechanism. Distinctness depends on retaining all three learned BiMaps and both ReEig stages; replacing the hierarchy by LogEig alone would be rejected as another normalization variant. No duplicate among attention/VQA/representation cards.
novelty_audit.source_code_evidence: spdnet_init_afew.m and vl_mybfc/vl_myrec/vl_mylog implement the complete six-stage SPD hierarchy.
